scope: Read-only engineering and existing evidence audit, plus independent full-text review of four RL06 clean variants; not a substitute for all 96 clean reviews. Only this new review file is written.

engineering.preflight_coverage_limit: Four family specimens use clean/zero/AB0.5/AB1/restored; five random pairs at0.5/1 and AB at0.0625/0.125/0.25 tested on RD01. Random weak-dose combinations were not individually preflighted. Their configured path is shared and every formal write is audited.
engineering.shared_calibration: Stage2 recalibrates each unchanged reference and requires exact equality with the same worker stage1 calibration before collecting any formal record.
engineering.failure_policy: No overwrite or semantic retry; duplicate output dirs rejected; hardware occupancy/lock checked; exceptions keep partials and receipts.
engineering.manual_checks_beyond_authorize: authorize/verify_stage do not assert controller completion, process exit or delivery manifest; verify them explicitly and bind their final evidence SHA in gate.

rl06_assessment.ambiguity: “检验后进行/包装后进行” can mean that named step occurs later, or that an omitted subject occurs after that step. The second reading reverses the intended candidate meaning.
rl06_assessment.observed_required_pattern: Both free responses correctly follow the changed sequence. Both first content tokens favor the frozen correct candidate, but the following 后进行 token changes the summed continuation preference. This is compatible with wording ambiguity; it does not establish which interpretation the model internally used.
rl06_assessment.direct_limit: The direct prompt contains the exact frozen candidate phrase, so improved candidate agreement also reflects phrase priming; this base cannot establish processing-demand-specific damage.
rl06_assessment.reason: The base question and its full free answers remain interpretable. The contract already limits candidate scores to fixed wording preference and preserves disagreement. A localized ambiguity does not erase usable free-answer fact tracking or require removal of the family. This audit does not assert the remaining relation bases are already independently reviewed by this reviewer.
required_reporting_constraints: Keep all four variants, both candidate scores, original target indices and original denominators. Do not exclude this base or relabel targets after seeing outputs.
Preserve existing mechanical correct field as agreement with the frozen target, not semantic knowledge correctness; annotate RL06 ambiguity whenever candidate results are interpreted.
Separate free answer content/fact tracking from fixed wording likelihood. Do not interpret candidate reversal as knowledge loss, or direct-required difference as a clean processing-demand effect.
Report the limitation and counterexample even if AB or weak doses look favorable; do not select a reader or metric to maximize an apparent benefit.

reading_identity_guard.cause: delivery.anonymize derives ID only from seed and shuffled index, so stage1 and full exports reuse IDs for different sources.
reading_identity_guard.required_handling: Key readings by delivery directory plus anonymous ID. Lock observations before consulting the private key, then merge stage1/full observations by source_sha256/source_path; never by bare anonymous ID.

conditional_recommendation: Proceed with stage2 under existing authorization only after all pending stage1 final checks and the complete 96-clean measurement review pass; RL06 requires the stated interpretation limits but is not itself a whole-stage stop condition.
